headline: Resolution giving site control of 142 South Bend Street to the Pawtucket School Committee for a new unified high school.
summary: The meeting covers a resolution giving the Pawtucket School Committee site control of 142 South Bend Street. The site is for building a new unified high school in the City of Pawtucket.
items: Public input period. Sign in or join via Zoom 10 minutes before the meeting.
Resolution providing site control of 142 South Bend Street to the Pawtucket School Committee for construction of a new unified high school in the City of Pawtucket.
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, Second Floor, Room 204, 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island; parking lot entrance at 75 Sabin Street

Second Floor – Room 204, Parking Lot Entrance at 75 Sabin Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
2. RESOLUTION PROVIDING SITE CONTROL OF 142 SOUTH BEND STREET TO THE 
PAWTUCKET SCHOOL COMMITTEE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW UNIFIED HIGH 
SCHOOL IN THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET
